_comment: Golden perceptual hashes for cross-engine video engine parity tests.
Each entry maps a scene file + sample time to a perceptual hash and tolerance.
scene:    relative path to the scene JSON in shared/scenes/
engine:   'web' | 'native' — which engine produced this golden
samples:  array of { timeSec, hash, tolerance }
The hash is a 64-bit average hash (aHash) computed from an 8x8 grayscale
downsample of the rendered RGBA frame. tolerance is the maximum Hamming
distance allowed between the engine's hash and the golden for a pass.
